name: Platformer Gemstone Highlight Variant R
instruction: Keep the Level node aligned to the viewport with position (188.509, -25.555), scale (0.63, 0.63), and rotation 0.16 radians. Keep Sprite2D using assets/sprites/platformer_coins.jpg with centered set to false. Add a Node2D named GemstoneHighlights under the Level node. Inside GemstoneHighlights, create a semi-transparent Polygon2D named GemstoneHighlight. Shape and place the polygon so it closely covers the gemstone.

metadata.transcript_excerpt: draw a tight semi-transparent polygon highlight over the gemstone with Level scale Vector2(0.63, 0.63) and rotation 0.16

key_properties.GemstoneHighlight.effective_alpha: semi-transparent via color.a * modulate.a, strictly between 0 and 1
key_properties.GemstoneHighlight.color_range: purple or pink-purple tint, approximately within validator ranges
